label: qa-agent-round-2
message:
# QA agent: verify story ABC-123

Work story `ABC-123`, which is in deployment review.

Load and follow the `qa-verification` skill for this story, including its evidence capture and its closing status decision.

Verify the story against the deployed build: read its acceptance criteria and its Definition of Done, confirm the deployed build is the merged commit, verify each acceptance criterion on the deployed environment, run each Definition of Done check, and record reproducible evidence for each item.

Hand back:

- the story's final state;
- the verdict and evidence for each acceptance criterion and each Definition of Done item;
- any item left outstanding, with its owner;
- any incidental defect you noted, even one that does not keep the story from Done;
- each PR you merged, with the head SHA its review of record covered.

Merge rules: a review of record binds only to the exact head it reviewed, so any change to the head, including an update-branch, needs a delta review posted before merging; every merge must run the merge guard and carry the reviewed full head SHA as the expected-head condition (on GitHub, `gh pr merge <n> --match-head-commit <full reviewed SHA>`).

Work in your own subdirectory of the scratch directory, `{run_dir}/qa-agent-round-2/`, never another role's files.

Never write secrets to files or argv.

Track your work: before starting, write a fine-grained checklist file at `{run_dir}/qa-agent-round-2/qa-agent-round-2-todo.md` with `- [ ]` and `- [x]` items, one per acceptance criterion and per Definition of Done box, per environment setup, the evidence PR, and the closing status decision, the current step marked `(in progress)`, and update it at every step.
